remarks: Welcome to 10 Ann Street #209 at Sono Lofts-a stunning & spacious 1-bedroom corner unit designed for effortless modern living in the heart of SONO. Step inside to a bright, open-concept space featuring a sleek contemporary kitchen with stainless steel appliances, a large island with granite countertops, & modern woven pendant lights-perfect for entertaining. The kitchen area features stylish wood panels with tile, adding warmth & character. The primary bedroom is equally stylish, highlighted by a matching woven chandelier & a generous closet space.  The bathroom is a sophisticated retreat with concrete flooring, a modern vanity, a tub, & floor-to-ceiling white tile for a spa-like feel. A new showerhead enhances comfort, while the laundry & water heater closet also feature durable concrete flooring. This unit boasts new electric shades for added convenience. With soaring 10-foot ceilings & oversized windows, natural light floods the space. The unit is freshly painted & deep cleaned, awaiting your own personally creative style & aesthetic.  Enjoy ample storage, including a walk-in coat closet, a pantry, and a storage/laundry closet with the new washer/dryer combo.   Low HOA! Building includes workout room/gym, bike storage & personal storage unit. Nestled in the heart of SONO, this condo has unbeatable walkability to top destinations like the Maritime Aquarium, Oyster Park, and the SoNo Collection Mall. Commuting is effortless with Metro North and major highway
